properties.OutageReportInfo: Newfoundland & Labrador Hydro wishes to advise its customers of an unplanned power outage for Island Harbour, Deep Bay, Seldom and Stag Harbour, the outage is under investigation and there is no ETA at this time.   Newfoundland and Labrador Hydro apologizes to its customers for any inconvenience this outage may cause.
properties.Title: Under Investigation
